publication: Local test inputs only. No ISO, kernel, prepared image, handoff or build tag published; existing release hold remains active.
scope: Retain real Ethernet, DHCP/DNS, HTTP preview, Network Manager and request recovery while enabling isolated UEFI application execution. This is not a modern browser or TLS acceptance result.
source_state: Working tree based on 9890d0b before this coherent source iteration is committed; guest provenance is identified by exact hashes below.

test_configuration.network: QEMU user networking, local deterministic HTTP/UDP-DNS fixtures
test_configuration.input: Native qemu-xhci USB keyboard and tablet

artifact_guards.enforcement: Guest compares copied ISO embedded kernel or the installed ESP EFI/CHOS/CHOS.ELF against the supplied symbols before QEMU starts. Installed parsing checks GPT CRC/extent, ESP GUID, FAT32 geometry and bounded directory/file chains. Probes remain read-only.
covered_cases: ISO multicluster extraction and exact digest
actual installed ESP path extracted and compared
stale supplied kernel present elsewhere on disk is rejected
corrupt GPT rejected before FAT access

retained_failures.diagnosis: The exploratory snapshot paired ISO kernel SHA8a756e0138c3bee3d8826644b273f89e7aa5f3d250a03ee23f85e89de4ff8588 with stale symbol kernel SHA8999af0582b28b962f2321cd863492f6badf36c12e0c30025017ba68cb6b450f. Probes read zeros at wrong offsets and falsely timed out waiting for DHCP. Exact embedded extraction diagnosed the mismatch; mandatory artifact guards now reject it before launch.

With exact ISO/symbol pair, real DHCP/EL0 HTTP redirect/body and HTTPS refusal worked; the old fixture then sent privileged dnsserver to the newly isolated ordinary Console, which did not expose that setter. Configuration moved to the trusted serial OS command while the actual browser remains EL0. Later complete final9 profiles pass.

limits: The tested browser is the existing HTTP preview. HTTPS is correctly refused; no modern HTML/CSS/JavaScript engine, certificate validation or TLS transport is established here.
Local HTTP fixtures do not establish public internet reachability or standards conformance.
The final9 UEFI MMU/application profile has QEMU evidence only; the user-confirmed earlier Fusion Ethernet build remains distinct. No independent Fusion retest or physical Pi5/laptop test is claimed.

Manager configuration/persistence evidence uses its exact build8 installed kernel; final9 network evidence uses the exact newer kernel with trusted built-in Console retention. This is a scoped regression report, not a final release qualification.
